title: Introducing DYOR: Your Research Hub for Binance Alpha Tokens
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce the launch of  DYOR , a dedicated research hub built to bring on-chain transparency to your fingertips. In the complex world of crypto, we believe in empowering our users with the facts they need to make their own informed decisions. DYOR addresses the challenge of fragmented and opaque on-chain data. It aggregates key project and market metrics into a single, easy-to-use interface, lowering the barrier to quality research for all users. Our goal is to present objective, factual data, not trading direction. Key Metrics on DYOR Market Info:  Gain insights into market dynamics with data on exchange balances, low float, and liquidity withdrawal alerts. Trading Data:  Analyze trading sentiment with data on DEX pool liquidity and funding rates. Token Unlock:  Understand a token's distribution structure, view upcoming unlock schedules and events, and check the status of locked-up wallet addresses. Basics:  Assess a project's health and activity through metrics like Total Value Locked (TVL), fees, revenue, team member profiles, and development updates from official GitHub and X channels. Note : Metric availability varies by token as coverage expands. How to Access DYOR The DYOR is now available for all Binance Alpha tokens. To access it: Open the Binance app and make sure the Exchange toggle is enabled at the top. Navigate to the Spot Trading page of a supported Alpha token.  Click on the  [DYOR]  tab. We will be progressively expanding coverage to more tokens in the future. Please Note:   The data presented in DYOR is presented on an “as is” basis for informational purposes only and should not be interpreted as financial or investment advice, nor is it a recommendation to trade. Binance remains platform-neutral, presenting factual data to support your own research. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-05-25
